sources.title: GitHub - riceharvest/moth: moth: a tiny 112M local companion chatbot, a ...
sources.snippet: moth is a silly little companion, not an assistant. It's a tiny 112M-parameter model that thinks it's a silkmoth living on your graphics card. It's a bit dim, gets things sweetly wrong, and will not fix your code. It keeps you company while your coding agent works: hook it up and it reacts to each agent turn's final message with a cute misreading.

sources.title: GitHub - kishlay42/Moth-ai
sources.snippet: Overview Moth AI is the first terminal-native coding assistant built from the ground up to treat local and open-source LLMs as first-class citizens. While others lock you into proprietary models or cloud subscripts, Moth is truly open source—in code, philosophy, and model support.
